card_lines: TOP: use your 2 Emperor attempts on Autistocat and push past showdown 77. Pulse: stand on the small platform next to the boss and auto attack so the skulls bounce; Skull + Aura only, 2nd-page damage talents, boost foods. Big pushes are best saved for statue week.
Coming up: showdown 78: 0.05x Windwalker Extra Dust, showdown 79: +10% Drop Rate, showdown 80: 0.01x Summoning Winner Bonuses, showdown 81: 0.3x Ninja Stealth.
